description: In front of you on the bed is a white toy airplane-like build with a few loose white block pieces nearby and a pink pillow against the headboard. The left hand stays planted on the main white build to steady it as a left-hand object, while the right hand reaches in from the right, pinches a small white block on top, lifts it up and away, then moves down and sets that piece onto the bed near the other loose parts, leaving the main build still held by the left hand.
